activities.instruction: Answer using the cited text. Equivalent accurate wording is acceptable; support interpretations with details.

items.question: Name two destination countries listed in the work-abroad passage.
items.modelAnswer: The UAE and Oman are examples. Saudi Arabia, Qatar and Bahrain are also listed.

items.question: What skill does the passage particularly encourage workers to develop?
items.modelAnswer: It encourages language skills, including English, Arabic or other languages used where they will work.

items.question: How can better employment help workers and their families in the passage?
items.modelAnswer: Better work and fairer pay can help workers support their families and contribute to the economy.

items.question: Where does Dr Arman work in Section C?
items.modelAnswer: He works in a hospital in Cairo, Egypt.

items.question: Name two places Dr Arman suggests visiting.
items.modelAnswer: He suggests the Cairo Museum and the Pyramids. Port Suez is also mentioned.
